name: Thumbnail Crossfade Gallery
description: Compact gallery with one large square preview and a vertical column of four thumbnails. Selecting a thumbnail crossfades and slightly scales the preview, with a glass caption chip.
contents: Large square preview with gradient and glass name chip
Vertical column of four clickable thumbnails
Optional film grain overlay and soft accent glow
behavior: Clicking a thumbnail crossfades the preview image with a subtle scale settle
Active thumbnail is fully opaque with an accent outline, others are dimmed and brighten on hover
Layout shrinks thumbnails on small screens
editableByProps: Images, names, heading and caption text

needsCodeEdit.change: Show more or fewer than four images
Change the crossfade duration or easing
needsCodeEdit.where: transition-[opacity,transform] classes on the preview img

fixed: Only the first four images are used
Grain overlay is a fixed full-viewport layer above the page when enabled
Uses Cormorant Garamond and Josefin Sans through next/font/google
Fills at least the viewport height and centers the gallery
